## Story

- **As a <role>**  [Add the role. For example "As a customer"]
- **I want to <action>**  [What do you want to do. For example "I want to add cards"]
- **in order to <purpose>**  [Positive effect of the action. For example "In order to study them"]  

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given [context], when [action], then [outcome]
- For example: The add button should have the background color blue.

## Priority

- define the priority of the story. [Low, Mid, High]

## Effort
 
- Estimate the effort of the story using Planning Poker
